faq.0.question: Baara jumɛn Nocoding bɛ se ka kɛ?
faq.0.answer: An bɛ mɔgɔ yɛrɛ ka portofoliyo walima CV wɛbusitiw, landing page walima kɔmpani jira, kunnafoni ni baarakɛcogo sistɛmuw, ani jago baarasira yɛrɛbaara dilan.
faq.1.question: Dilanni bɛ mɛn cogo di?
faq.1.answer: Portofoliyo, CV walima landing page nɔgɔman bɛ mɛn don 1 ka se 3 ma baara kɔnɔ fɛnw labɛnnen kɔ. Porozɛ belebelew bɛ bɔ baaraw, jɛkabɔw ani hakilina di waati kan.
faq.2.question: Dilanni ni baaraw bɛ se ka yɛlɛma wa?
faq.2.answer: Ɔwɔ. Dilanni, sɛbɛ cɛsiri, baaraw ni baarasira bɛ se ka labɛn i ka laɲini kɔrɔ. Dilanni bɛ lajɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ sani dilanni ka damine.
faq.3.question: Mun bɛ sɔngɔ kɔnɔ?
faq.3.answer: Sɔngɔ bɛ dilanni bɛɛ ta pakɛ ni baara sɔnnen kɔrɔ. Pakɛ Fitinin kɔnɔ ɲɛnabɔli ni domɛni bɛ fu san 1 kɔnɔ, Pakɛ Belebele kɔnɔ ɲɛnabɔli ni hosting bɛ fu san 1 kɔnɔ.

project.category.ecoswap: Fɛn kɔrɔw sanni ni feere wɛbusiti
project.description.ecoswap: Internɛti sugu min bɛ fɛn kɔrɔw san ani k'u feere. Mɔgɔ bɛ se ka fɛn dɔ da yen, k'a ɲini ani k'a san nɔgɔya la telefɔni walima ordinatɛri kan.
project.description.wiboost: Internɛti dukan min bɛ dijitali baaraw feere i n'a fɔ ɲɛnajɛ wari fara, datakɛ pakɛw ani appu belebelew, ni sanbaga wari mara ani feerelaw ka porogaramu ye.
project.description.ahawi: Mɔgɔ yɛrɛ ka portofoliyo wɛbusiti min dilannen bɛ ji fɛtɔ ɲɛnajɛ cogo la ani kan fila la, ka mɔgɔ yɛrɛ, baara ni wele kunnafoniw jira.
project.description.abdi: Sɛbɛnni sistɛmu min bɛ masasow baarakɛlaw (abdi dalem) ka Keraton Surakarta ye: ka i tɔgɔ sɛbɛn, mɔgɔ yɛrɛ kunnafoniw, baara waati sɛbɛnni, na ni taa ani kardi bɔli.
project.description.sfarm: Appu min bɛ dugu ka sɛnɛkɛyɔrɔ ɲɛnabɔ, jɛgɛ sɔnnen ni baganw ta: don o don sɛbɛnni, feereli, wari bɔli ani wari sɛbɛnniw.
project.description.payu: Platfɔrɔmu min bɛ baara ɲini mɔgɔw ni baarakɛla yɛrɛw jɛ ɲɔgɔn na. Baara ɲinilaw bɛ sara di, baarakɛlaw bɛ baara ban, saraka bɛ kɛ QRIS fɛ.
project.description.darcasual: Internɛti catalɔgi min kɔnɔ fɛn waa kelen ka caya bɛ yen. Sanbagaw bɛ se k'u ɲini, k'u suguya sugandi ani k'u ɲini kosɛbɛ WhatsApp fɛ.
project.description.ianprem: Internɛti dukan min bɛ appu belebelew kɔntiw feere i n'a fɔ Netflix ni Spotify. Sanbagaw bɛ sugandi ani ka sara u yɛrɛ ma, kuntigiw bɛ fɛnw ni feereliw ɲɛnabɔ.
project.description.alengka: Internɛti catalɔgi min kɔnɔ so kɔnɔ ni so kɔfɛ minɛnw bɛ yen kafew, restoranw ani somɔgɔw ye. Ɲɛnajɛlaw bɛ se ka u lajɛ ka laadili ɲini WhatsApp fɛ.
project.description.sdn: Kalanso fɔlɔ yɛrɛ ka wɛbusiti min kɔnɔ kalanso jira, kalanden kura donni kunnafoni, karamɔgɔw tɔgɔw, kalan kɔfɛ baaraw ani kalandenw ka ɲɛtaa bɛ yen.
project.description.furnix: Internɛti catalɔgi min kɔnɔ nɛgɛ mɔbiliw bɛ Jepara kafew, restoranw ani somɔgɔw ye. Ɲɛnajɛlaw bɛ fɛnw sugandi ka u ɲini u sago la.
project.description.clothique: Fini internɛti dukan min dafalen don: catalɔgi, sanni kɔrɔfɔ, internɛti saraka, blɔgi ani kuntigi yɔrɔ min bɛ ɲininiw ni sɛbɛnniw ɲɛnabɔ.
project.description.agli: Minɛn min bɛ kunnafoni baara ka bɛnkan dɛmɛ ka kunnafoni minnu lajɛra ka caya, olu misaliw da ɲɔgɔn kɔrɔ, cogo ye jateminɛ ani sɛbɛnni kura kɔrɔw dilan.
project.description.nebulist: Feereli dɛmɛbaga min bɛ AI baara kɛ, min bɛ feereli sira, sanbaga kunnafoni ni kunnafoni ci misaliw dilan ka bɔ fɛn kunnafoni la.
project.description.carbonfi: Dijitali wari appu min bɛ kabɔn jɔ ye (sara min bɛ di fɛn dɔgɔya kosɛbɛ) ani sara kunnafoni minnu bɛ dugukolo dɛmɛ.
project.description.protectedpay: Dijitali wari ci appu min bɛ lakana: wari bɛ bɔ tuma min a sɔrɔla dɔrɔn, ni jɛkulu saraka ani mara.
project.description.pedulichain: Dɛmɛ di platfɔrɔmu min jɛlen don: dɛmɛ o dɛmɛ ni wari baarali cogo bɛ sɛbɛn badaa ani mɔgɔ bɛɛ bɛ se k'a ye.
project.description.astra: AI dɛmɛbaga min bɛ se ka kuma a fɛ walisa dijitali nafolow ɲɛnabɔ, i n'a fɔ tokɛn ci walima dijitali ɲɛnajɛ fɛnw dilan, sɛbɛnni dɔnni tɛ mako.
project.description.auditfi: AI kan lakanani lajɛlan dijitali wari porogaramuw ye min bɛ yɔrɔ barikantanw sɔrɔ ani ka sɛbɛnni dilan sekɔndi damadɔ kɔnɔ.
project.description.p2p: Platfɔrɔmu min bɛ dijitali nafolow tɔɔrɔ baarakɛlaw cɛ ka ɲɔgɔn bolo, ni feereli lakanani ani kuntigi yɔrɔ min bɛ platfɔrɔmu ɲɛnabɔ.

project.description.tiptap: Platfɔrɔmu min bɛ kunnafoni dilannikɛlaw dɛmɛ ka dɛmɛsara sɔrɔ ɲɛnajɛlaw fɛ dijitali wari walima dijitali ɲɛnajɛ fɛnw la, ni lasɔmini live waati la.
project.description.senkus: Internɛti ŋɛnɛ min dilannen don ka sayansi ni alikimi kan: ŋɛnɛkɛlaw bɛ ji dilan ka fara ɲɔgɔn kan, dijitali fɛnw lajɛ ani ka ɲɔgɔn kɛlɛ ɲɛnɛkɔrɔ la.
project.description.quickstock: Ordinatɛri appu min bɛ fini dukan fɛn mara ɲɛnabɔ: feereliw, fɛn bɔli feerelaw fɛ ani fɛn lisiw sɛbɛn, ni sira min bɛ baarakɛla o baarakɛla ka baara kɔrɔ la.
